elaine: Heads up — staging signer rotation for airgap image bundles tonight 22:00 UTC. Need a quick gate runbook and to pause new artifact promotions.

mike: ETA on how long the rotation will block promotions?

elaine: ~15m for key swap + 10m for manifest republish + 5m for CI reconciliation. Total ~30m worst-case.

sam: @elaine can packaging-ci hold new promotions at T-10?

packaging-ci: Packaging CI: pausing auto-promote on the vpc-offline channel now. Will ack when blocked.

packaging-ci: Packaging CI: blocked — all auto-promote hooks disabled.

adrian: Any special steps for mirror syncers or checksum reingesters? We should avoid dual-signing mismatches.

elaine: good call. After republish we'll push a transient 'staged' tag, run mirrors, verify cosign sigs sha256, then swap tags to final. Mirror ops: watch for signer mismatch alerts.

mike: I'll prepare the rollback criteria: if manifest publish fails or mirrors report >1% missing shards after 20m, abort and revert signer key (dev-signer-old).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: :calendar: Scheduled: signer-rotation-staging at 2026-03-21T22:00:00Z. Window 30m. Notifying oncall.

sam: oncall alerted. I'll be online for the window.

elaine: quick checklist for the run —
1) pause promotions (done)
2) stop new packaging runs (packaging-ci done)
3) rotate cosign key on signer service
4) republish manifests with staged tag
5) run mirror verification script `scripts/mirror-verify.sh staged`
6) swap tags and unpause promotions

adrian: adding: preflight smoke deploy to a single test vpc instance after swap.

elaine: will run smoke deploy and post-metrics check (latency & fetch success). If any failures ping #eng-oncall and revert.

mike: thanks — i'll prepare release notes blurb and rollback steps. good luck :thumbsup:

elaine: thanks team. I'll post a short postmortem if anything goes weird.
